name: download-unreachable
description: The export completes and publishes a resultsFileUrl the scanner cannot fetch -- here a scheme-less path, which is what a misconfigured object-store front end or an egress proxy rewrite produces. The raw http_get returns no response for a transport-level failure, so reading download_response.status_code off it ended the whole run instead of reporting a failed download. The download is guarded, so the run finishes cleanly with zero assets and a log line naming the URL.

log_contains: Failed to download export results from exports/exp-0004.csv
No rows returned from Nexthink export workflow
